test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No carrots are beets.

Some carrots are gingers.

Some gingers are beets.

**Conclusions:**

I. All beets are gingers.

II. Some gingers are carrots.

III. Some beets are carrots.

options.text: Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and III follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc617ab90fe5f630716fdff2d12345999229cdb4fde0f82b11304488dfb6049b.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All beets are gingers. → Does not follow (As, Some gingers are beets, which means some beets are gingers)

II. Some gingers are carrots. → **Follows** (As, Some carrots are gingers, which means Some gingers are carrots)

III. Some beets are carrots. → Does not follow (As, No carrots are beets, which means no beets are carrots)

Hence, ‘**Only conclusion II follows**’ is the correct answer.
